title: Ye Qing's True Feelings
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's words before losing consciousness struck like thunder, Chen Ji gripped her wrist tightly—he had never seen his own mother, yet too many people knew that name. In the distance, the distinctive horn of the Tianqing Sect sounded, and Ling Yuan's forces had already surrounded this valley.

text.content: Chen Ji stood at the edge of the shattered cliff, the words of the Demonic Path commander cutting his heart like a dull blade, again and again. Ye Qing's betrayal—these four characters sounded so ironic now. He slowly closed his eyes, fingers tracing the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his garments. Those threads of destiny he thought he had grasped were now collapsing and reorganizing. The howling wind tousled his bangs, yet could not disperse the swirling doubts in his heart.

dialogue.content: (The moment his fingers touched the fragment, his voice cold as if emanating from the Nine Abysses) Ye Qing... You better give me a reason that convinces me. Otherwise, I'll show you what the price of the Tianji Record truly means.

text.content: The text of the Tianji Record flickered in his mind, a blurred image gradually becoming clear—Ye Qing was forcibly fed a pitch-black elixir, its surface flowing with unique patterns of the Heavenly Eye. He saw the struggle and despair in Ye Qing's eyes, witnessed her using every last spark of consciousness to protect someone even after being controlled. The person she protected... was him, Chen Ji.

Memories reassembled like shattered mirror fragments. Chen Ji saw Ye Qing imprisoned in a Holy Sect dungeon, a black-robed figure forcing a control elixir down her throat, noticed tears streaming from her eyes—those tears were not shed for herself, but for the person she could not protect. Heavenly Eye... that damned existence again.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's retrospection consumed an entire hour of Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate, yet the truth had surfaced. Now he stood at the entrance of the Holy Sect's secret stronghold, where Ye Qing was imprisoned. He needed to make a choice—

choices.description: Ye Qing was his only Demonic Path ally, a victim of fate's manipulation. Even if it meant depleting more of his Heavenly Fate, he would rescue her.
choices.visible_cost: Consume significant Heavenly Fate, potentially endangering subsequent plans
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete trust, unlock 'Shared Destiny' prerequisite conditions
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate will drop to a dangerous threshold

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pushing open the rusted iron door. The damp corridor was filled with the stench of blood and decay, every step pressing upon his taut heartstrings. Turning the final corner, he saw her—

choices.description: First confirm whether Ye Qing is truly innocent, then decide whether to act. He cannot let emotions cloud his judgment.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing may continue suffering torment
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more clues about the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal rescue timing

text.content: Chen Ji concealed his aura, retreating into the shadows. The Tianji Record flickered again, revealing more visions—Ye Qing repeatedly calling out a name in her unconscious state, over and over.

The seal on memories finally cracked open. Chen Ji witnessed an unimaginable scene—when Ye Qing was forcibly administered the control elixir by the Heavenly Eye's emissary, her lips moved silently, as if speaking. He deciphered the lip movement: 'I'm sorry, I must protect him.' That 'him' was Chen Ji himself.

Chen Ji's fist clenched tightly, knuckles whitening. He finally understood why Ye Qing had inexplicably cooperated with him, why she always appeared at critical moments, why her 'betrayal' seemed so contradictory—all the anomalies now made sense. She was no traitor; she was protecting him in her own way.

Navigating through layers of guards, Chen Ji finally arrived at Ye Qing's cell. It was a damp, gloomy cavern with icy droplets continuously falling from the rock walls. She hung suspended in mid-air by chains, garments torn, body covered in wounds, blood dripping from her toes into puddles below, creating tiny ripples. Her head hung low, black hair obscuring most of her face.

dialogue.content: (His voice hoarse, barely recognizable from its original cold clarity) Ye Qing... I'm here.

text.content: Ye Qing slowly raised her head, her once beautiful and striking face now covered with wounds, but those eyes remained clear—though marked with layers of weariness and fatigue. Upon seeing Chen Ji, her pupils contracted sharply, her lips trembling violently.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji extended his hand, fingertips brushing Ye Qing's icy cheek. Her body trembled slightly, her eyes filled with too many complex emotions. And Chen Ji had to make a decision—

choices.text: Use fate to break the seal
choices.description: Consuming a massive amount of karmic power to forcibly unseal the Control Pill. This will greatly reduce Chen Ji's combat power.
choices.visible_cost: Karmic power greatly consumed, combat power temporarily decreased
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing fully recovered, regaining the Demonic Path Mist ability
choices.risk_hint: The unsealing process is perilous, may suffer backlash

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, forming seals with both hands as the power of the Tianji Record gathered into dazzling golden light in his palm. He pressed his palm against Ye Qing's forehead and low growled: 'Break for me!'

choices.text: First sever the iron chains and take her away
choices.description: First ensure Ye Qing's safety, the sealing problem can be solved later.
choices.visible_cost: The seal is not removed, Ye Qing still risks being controlled
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may lose control at critical moments

text.content: Chen Ji drew his sword to sever the iron chains, and Ye Qing's body limply fell toward him. He caught her in his arms, feeling how terrifyingly light she was—the torture of this period had made her gaunt beyond recognition.

Golden light and black energy collided violently in the dungeon, each impact making Chen Ji feel as if his soul was being torn apart. He gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, blood seeping from the corners of his eyes, staining half his cheek red. But he didn't retreat; instead, he poured more power into that golden light.

Crack—a crisp shattering sound rang out as that pitch-black elixir finally disintegrated within Ye Qing's body, turning into wisps of black smoke that dissipated into the air. And Chen Ji, due to the backlash of power, knelt on one knee, gasping heavily. His face was as pale as paper, and his Heavenly Fate had been completely depleted.

dialogue.content: (The confusion in her eyes gradually fading, replaced by sharp pain and self-blame, tears bursting forth) Chen Ji... how could you be so foolish... for me... it's not worth it...

text.content: Chen Ji barely managed to prop himself up, reaching out to wipe the tears from Ye Qing's face, a faint smile curling at the corners of his lips. That smile held none of his usual coldness and calculation, only pure tenderness.

dialogue.content: (Gently pulling her into his embrace, his voice hoarse yet resolute) Whether it's worth it or not is not for you to decide. Ye Qing, I've seen everything you've sacrificed for me. From now on, no one will lay a finger on you.

text.content: Ye Qing trembled in his embrace, years of grievances and suppression breaking through at this moment. She wept like a child, her fingers gripping Chen Ji's robes tightly as if afraid this was merely a dream. She knew whose mother Chen Ji was—that woman whose clan was annihilated by Tianqing Sect—and she should have been her most devoted guardian.

dialogue.content: (Sobbing uncontrollably, voice faltering) I'm sorry... I failed to protect her... your mother... when Tianqing Sect's people hunted her down... I was blocked by the Holy Sect's people... I watched her die right before my eyes... yet I could do nothing...

text.content: Chen Ji's arms around Ye Qing suddenly tightened, his knuckles turning white. He had never met his mother; everything about her was a void. Yet now, this woman weeping before him was a witness to his mother's fate. A horn sounded from outside the cave—Tianqing Sect's pursuers had arrived.

dialogue.content: (Voice low, the tenderness in his eyes gradually replaced by ice-cold determination) Tell me about my mother when we have the chance. For now, let's leave this place. (Rising to his feet, placing Ye Qing securely behind him) Whoever comes tonight, none shall leave alive.

text.content: Ye Qing wiped away her tears, and a smile also appeared at the corners of her lips—that was the relief of regaining freedom, and also trust in Chen Ji. She knew that from this moment, she was no longer alone. Torches lit up on the distant mountain peaks—Ling Yuan's forces had surrounded this area—and this was merely the beginning of a greater storm.
